title: Web fetch
line: Bring a page’s content into the session as readable text.

beats.caption: You ask what changed in the demo release.
Web fetch pulls the release notes into the session.
beats.label: pi-web-fetch

beats.caption: The agent can point to the described change.

takeaway.title: Keep the source with the answer
takeaway.line: Read the extracted page and use the link to check it.

notes: The release notes come from a local GitHub CLI fixture. No GitHub account or real release is used.

title.text: When the answer lives in release notes, you can bring the source into the session as text.

scene.text: Web fetch reads this sample GitHub release and returns its notes. The agent uses the text to find which command line flag changed.

takeaway.text: Keep the source handy when you use the answer. It gives you somewhere to check what the release actually says.
